finding: The V7 Local Factor repair now produces marginal null-preserving pair p-values, but ordinary BH at q=0.10 is not automatically FDR-valid for the strongly overlapping pair family. Pair tests share targets, controls, factors and bootstrap panels. Valid marginal p-values are necessary but not sufficient; ordinary BH additionally needs an independence/PRDS-type dependence condition. A sharp arbitrary-dependence construction with exactly 1322 valid marginal null p-values has global-null FDR q*H_m = 0.77645 under BH q=0.10.
required_successor_contract: Preserve the pair-common factor, null-preserving increment bootstrap, intersection-union marginal pair p-values and all timing/TTR/hedge repairs in PR 464.
Before interpreting BH q as calibrated FDR, either establish a justified positive-dependence/PRDS condition for the tested pair family or use a dependence-robust multiplicity procedure.

Use Benjamini-Yekutieli only as a conservative baseline; prefer a resampling/hierarchical procedure that exploits the already joint panel bootstrap and pre-specified event/relation families without screening on realized prices, residual z-scores or economic edge.
Only after the multiplicity layer is calibrated should shorter common samples, lower z thresholds or higher FDR levels be compared on common chronological data.
Promotion still requires prospective joint fill-state evidence, partial-fill abort/unwind economics and positive fill-conditioned PnL at 1x/1.5x/2x costs.
